timing_boundary: Single Wolfram kernel timings. Encoding symbol/leaf counts are exact for the declared formulation; timings are environment-specific.

invariant.statement: For any exact staged transform->quotient->target NAND circuit C_stage implementing partial target P, the exact direct circuit optimum C*(P) satisfies C*(P) <= size(C_stage).
invariant.consequence: Do not judge a staged quotient route by whether it beats the exact direct optimum in output gate count. Judge discovery, planning, verification, or matched restricted-search cost while preserving exactness.

stabilizer_discovery.pair_complexity: O(m^2) pair operations; O(m^2 n) bit complexity
stabilizer_discovery.dense_fourier_complexity: O(n 2^n) for dense Walsh-Hadamard evaluation over the full cube
stabilizer_discovery.claim_boundary: Polynomial discovery is for explicitly listed partial tables. It neither constructs a hard table nor gives a generic shortcut on succinct exponential domains.
